g.text: Shutdown — host-controlled flush before SDK disposal
STOPPED is a declaration before process exit,
not proof that the process has terminated.
SDK flush result or wait timeout
Flush completion is not a durable-delivery guarantee.
Close / dispose provider or host services
Flush BEFORE disposing .NET services: the SDK may initialize its HTTP client lazily.
The lifecycle library never owns SDK shutdown and adds no retries or delivery guarantees.
Abrupt process termination may skip this entire sequence.
